name: Nairobi National Museum
subtitle: A museum run by National Museums of Kenya on Museum Hill, begun in 1910 by naturalists.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Initiated in 1910 by a group of naturalists

facts.label: Opened
facts.value: Opened 22 September 1930 as the Coryndon Museum

facts.label: Reopened
facts.value: Reopened June 2008 under its current name

facts.label: Galleries
facts.value: Permanent galleries include The Cradle of Human Kind and The History of Kenya

parts.text: A museum run by National Museums of Kenya on Museum Hill, begun in 1910 by naturalists. Its permanent galleries cover human origins, mammals, Kenyan history and more.
